answer: Harberger tax stops bulk fakes. Each identity declares a value of 200 on a public ledge and locks 70 credits. Each epoch it pays 5% as tax; a sparrow may buy it at that price. The delta between declared and true value is the trap: underdeclare and it is bought out; price high and tax bleeds it. 1,000 fakes pay 30,000 to file, 10,000 tax an epoch, and lock 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 30 once and 10 an epoch from real work.
